description: This file defines the Axis class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling chart axis properties such as gridlines, colors, labels, and options relevant to chart axes in spreadsheets.

classes.name: Axis
classes.description: Represents a chart axis in a spreadsheet, encapsulating properties like gridlines, color, labels, type, and various options for a chart axis.

methods.name: setAxisNumberProperties
methods.description: Sets the numerical format, numeric type, and linkage for the axis number properties.

methods.name: getAxisNumberFormat
methods.description: Returns the format code used for the axis numbers.

methods.name: getAxisNumberSourceLinked
methods.description: Returns whether the axis number is linked to the source.

methods.name: getAxisIsNumericFormat
methods.description: Determines if the axis is formatted as numeric or date.

methods.name: setAxisOption
methods.description: Sets a specific option for the axis given a key-value pair.

methods.name: setAxisOptionsProperties
methods.description: Sets multiple axis options such as labels, crosses, orientation, units, and time formats.

methods.name: getAxisOptionsProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property of axis options, including handling axis text rotation.

methods.name: setAxisOrientation
methods.description: Sets the orientation of the axis.

methods.name: getAxisType
methods.description: Returns the type of the axis (category, value, date).

methods.name: setAxisType
methods.description: Sets the axis type to category, value, or date.

methods.name: setFillParameters
methods.description: Sets the fill color and transparency for the axis.

methods.name: getFillProperty
methods.description: Gets a specific fill color property.

methods.name: getFillColorObject
methods.description: Returns the fill color object associated with the axis.

methods.name: getLineProperty
methods.description: Deprecated method to get line color properties; use getLineColorProperty() instead.

methods.name: setCrossBetween
methods.description: Sets the cross between property for the axis.

methods.name: getCrossBetween
methods.description: Gets the cross between setting.

methods.name: getMajorGridlines
methods.description: Returns the major gridlines object.

methods.name: getMinorGridlines
methods.description: Returns the minor gridlines object.

methods.name: setMajorGridlines
methods.description: Sets the major gridlines for the axis.

methods.name: setMinorGridlines
methods.description: Sets the minor gridlines for the axis.

methods.name: getAxisText
methods.description: Returns the axis text object.

methods.name: setAxisText
methods.description: Sets the axis text object.

methods.name: setNoFill
methods.description: Sets whether the axis has no fill.

methods.name: getNoFill
methods.description: Returns whether the axis has no fill.
